title: 8 Things My AI Team
Can <g>Never</g> Do
subtitle: Written into the rulebook. No setting turns them off.

cards.title: Do the same job twice
cards.body: Every approved job runs once. Never again by mistake.

cards.title: Give itself more access
cards.body: New tools and rights come only from me.

cards.title: Touch another room's work
cards.body: Sales can't edit delivery. Each room stays in its lane.

cards.title: Change the memory's shape
cards.body: The ledger only changes through a reviewed update.

cards.title: Save a password in the code
Name a client in lessons
cards.body: What it learns is anonymised when written.

cards.title: Spend past its budget
cards.body: Every timer has a monthly limit. It stops there.
